scenes.motion_prompt: The same 2D illustrated character Bobo pushes the vacuum cleaner back and forth across the rug with a bored, deadpan expression, small puffs of dust kicking up into the air with each pass. A cloud of dust drifts up and tickles his nose, his face scrunches up, and he suddenly sneezes hard, his whole body jolting forward with the force of it. He pauses, sniffles, and wipes his nose with the back of his hand, then goes right back to vacuuming with the same unimpressed expression as if nothing happened. The desk lamp glow flickers subtly. Cozy relatable comedic energy, smooth continuous motion, no glitches, consistent character and art style.
